title: Count the flips

tutorial.text: Three X gates are fixed in place. Where does the qubit end up? Make it |0⟩.
tutorial.action: Count the flips, then add what is missing.

hints: An odd number of flips gives |1⟩.
why: Each pair of X gates cancels, so three X gates act like one X. One more makes the total even.
success: Even number of flips: back to |0⟩.
